manifest.description: Discover semantically duplicate Java behavior hidden behind different names, signatures, and call paths.
when_to_use: different Java methods or classes appear to enforce the same policy or solve the same domain problem under different names
clone detection is unlikely to catch the duplication because implementations are paraphrased
a correction plan needs canonical behavior plus redirect or delete slices
anti_patterns: do not use for lexical or AST clones a clone detector can report
do not use when differences are known intentional variants
do not use on non-Java targets
